snippet.title: Moros Protocol - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Moros Protocol, a pixel-painted sci-fi FPS roguelite where every battle is for survival. It's available to wishlist now on Steam, and is due for release in Autumn 2025. Want to see more? Try the free demo which will be available during Steam Next Fest in June. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #morosprotocol 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
